## Description

Verify the `replaceAnimation` prop of `Stack.Screen`: with
`pop` (the default) a replace plays the outgoing screen's pop animation and the
outgoing screen leaves on top; with `push` it plays the incoming screen's push
animation and the incoming screen covers the outgoing one. Every route carries a
different preset, so whose animation plays is visible. Pass: every replace plays
the expected animation in the expected draw order, no other screen of the stack
is ever visible, and the back gesture after a replace pops the new top with its
own animation. A replace with the default value at every depth, and a
multi-replace, are covered by `test-stack-animation-operations-android`.

## Note

- Wait for every transition to finish before the next tap.
- Static: the screen does not move and stays fully visible for the whole
  transition.
- "replaceAnimation" applies to every screen pushed from then on, so it is set
  before the replace that it is meant to affect.

## Steps

### Baseline

1. Launch the app and navigate to the **Stack Animation Replace** screen.

   - [ ] The screen is yellow with the title "Home · default",
         "replaceAnimation" reads `pop`, and "Pop" and every "Replace with …"
         button are disabled.

---

### Replace with `pop`

1. Tap "Push Right", then tap "Replace with Bottom" on "Right".

   - [ ] "Right" (blue) slides out to the right while "Bottom" (green) slides
         in from the left beside it.
   - [ ] "Bottom" does not rise from the bottom edge and "Home" is not visible.

2. On "Bottom", tap "Replace with Fade".

   - [ ] "Bottom" sinks to the bottom edge on top of a static "Fade" (red).

3. On "Fade", tap "Replace with Ios".

   - [ ] "Fade" fades out while "Ios" (purple) fades in; nothing slides.

4. On "Ios", tap "Pop".

   - [ ] "Ios" slides out to the right on top of "Home", which slides in from
         the left by about a third of the width and brightens.

5. Tap "Push Default", then tap "Replace with Right" on "Default".

   - [ ] iOS: "Default" (navy) slides out to the right on top of "Right", which
         slides in from the left by about a third of the width.
   - [ ] Android: "Default" (navy) slides a short distance to the right while
         fading out, on top of "Right", which slides in from the left by the
         same distance.
   - [ ] "Home" is not visible.

6. On "Right", tap "Pop".

   - [ ] "Right" slides out to the right while "Home" slides in from the left
         beside it.

---

### Replace with `push`

1. Set "replaceAnimation" to `push`, tap "Push Fade", then tap "Push Right" on
   "Fade", then tap "Replace with Bottom" on "Right".

   - [ ] "Bottom" rises from the bottom edge on top of a static "Right".
   - [ ] Neither "Fade" nor "Home" is visible.

2. On "Bottom", tap "Replace with Ios".

   - [ ] "Ios" slides in from the right on top of "Bottom", which moves left by
         about a third of the width and darkens underneath.

3. On "Ios", tap "Replace with Right".

   - [ ] "Right" slides in from the right while "Ios" slides out to the left
         beside it.

4. On "Right", tap "Replace with Fade".

   - [ ] "Right" fades out while "Fade" fades in; nothing slides.

5. On "Fade", tap "Pop" twice.

   - [ ] "Home" is shown with the title "Home · default" and
         "replaceAnimation" reads `push`.

## Steps - Android

### Predictive back after a replace

1. Set "replaceAnimation" to `pop`, tap "Push Fade", tap "Push Right" on
   "Fade", tap "Replace with Ios" on "Right", then drag from the left screen
   edge to the middle of the screen and hold.

   - [ ] "Ios" follows the finger to the right on top of "Fade", which is
         partly shifted left and darkened underneath.

2. Release the finger without moving it back.

   - [ ] "Ios" slides out to the right and "Fade" is shown with the title
         "Fade · fade".

3. On "Fade", tap "Pop".

   - [ ] "Fade" fades out while "Home" fades in; the title reads
         "Home · default" and "replaceAnimation" reads `pop`.

## Steps - iOS

### Back swipe and back button after a replace

1. Set "replaceAnimation" to `pop`, tap "Push Fade", tap "Push Right" on
   "Fade", tap "Replace with Ios" on "Right", then swipe from the left screen
   edge to the right and release past the middle.

   - [ ] "Ios" follows the finger to the right on top of "Fade", then slides
         out, and "Fade" is shown with the title "Fade · fade".

2. Tap "Push Ios", then tap the back button on "Ios".

   - [ ] "Ios" slides out to the right on top of "Fade", which slides in from
         the left by about a third of the width and brightens.

---

### Replace during a push

1. On "Fade", tap "Push Right 2000 ms + replace in 1 s".

   - [ ] "Right 2000 ms" (blue) slides in from the right on top of "Fade", then
         jumps to its final position about halfway in.
   - [ ] "Right 2000 ms" then slides out to the right while "Bottom" slides in
         from the left beside it; "Fade" is not visible.

2. On "Bottom", tap "Pop" twice.

   - [ ] "Home" is shown with the title "Home · default" and
         "replaceAnimation" reads `pop`.
